Bug_Title: "@NonNull" values should not be set to null
Bug_Explanation: The code contains intentional bugs where @NonNull values are set to null or could potentially be null. These bugs are demonstrated by setting the 'primary' field to null, returning a null from a method expected to return a non-null value, and failing to initialize a non-null field in the constructor.
Trigger_Explanation: The JUnit test cases trigger the bugs by invoking methods that set @NonNull values to null directly or indirectly. These invocations result in NullPointerExceptions due to uninitialized or null-assigned @NonNull fields or return values.
Bug_Trigger_Explanation: The test results show that all tests passed successfully without any exceptions or errors, indicating that the bug was not triggered during the test execution.
